metadata.title: The Well-Tempered clAIvier
metadata.subtitle: Fugue XVI in G minor, five voices: Fantasia e fuga a 5 per Reincken
metadata.composer: Claude / Sam (on "An Wasserflüssen Babylon"; after Reincken, BWV 653b and BWV 542)
metadata.instrument: Organ in spirit (three manual voices and double pedal); playable on one keyboard except at the summit

markers.label: Line 1 in the pedal, canon at 6 1/2 beats

Line 6 in the pedal, canon at 4 beats; augmented sixth at b37
Line 7: triplets and their mirror; canon at 3 1/2 beats
Line 8: E natural, knocking; canon at 3 beats
Line 9: chromatic fall; canon at 2 1/2 beats
Summit: line 10, canon at 1 1/2 beats, stretto of subject 10
